description: Run Claude Code over ACP on your GitHub Copilot subscription, set up from the plugin settings with a GitHub sign-in. Copilot's GPT, Gemini and Grok models sit next to Claude in the model picker, and in plan mode Claude waits for your go-ahead, even in Full Access. A usage page shows the token dashboard, each thread's Copilot credits appear under the prompt, and your premium-request quota shows in the provider usage panel. Requires Node.js, Claude Code and a GitHub Copilot subscription.
